object_description: Pavilion-like composition of subtly offset volumes with a minimal footprint
design_condition: The building is placed peripherally at a site corner and close to the existing ice rink, using offset volumes to fit the terrain lightly while connecting the park, surrounding paths, and diverse uses.

positive.statement: The minimal building footprint is convincing and is placed credibly within the future urban context.

position.rationale: Compact offset footprint is clearly visible across the top plan and elevations.

positive.statement: The subtly structured volumes create a well-proportioned lightness and a finely graduated fit into the terrain.

position.rationale: Offset layered masses and graduated heights are visible throughout the sampled envelope.

positive.statement: The pavilion-like appearance and reserved architecture establish a strong dialogue between building and landscape.

position.rationale: Low pavilion-like composition is identifiable in plan and all elevations.

positive.statement: The building is well accessible from all directions through external and internal paths, while the covered entrance creates an eventful relationship with nature and the uses.

position.rationale: Entrance is not distinct, but the south-west perimeter offers a constrained external access anchor.

positive.statement: The spatial organization provides an attractively designed entrance hall with good overview and orientation.

position.rationale: Interior hall is inferred near the accessible lower-central portion of the compact plan.

positive.statement: The combination of a solid base and timber upper floor is sensible from a design perspective.

position.target: solid base and timber upper floor
position.rationale: Horizontal layering is visible in elevations, though materials are not distinguishable.

positive.statement: The low degree of sealing, green roof, and proposed habitats support ecological sustainability.

position.rationale: Roof-level surface is localized over the rear offset volume; vegetation is not identifiable.

positive.statement: The location and structure of the new building provide optimal noise insulation for the open ice rink.

position.rationale: Adjacent open-rink context is approximated along the broad east-side edge.

positive.statement: The project has the lowest construction costs, excellent compactness, and strong resource efficiency.

position.rationale: Cost, compactness, and resource efficiency apply globally without one useful spatial referent.

negative.statement: The proposed relocation and addition of paths and area accesses, together with the topographical interventions, require review.

position.rationale: External circulation is approximated around the south-west and lower perimeter.

negative.statement: Opening the edge vegetation conflicts with the character of the existing park, and the protected trees and hedges must not be loosened.

position.rationale: Park-edge vegetation is inferred along the western and northern perimeter.

negative.statement: The additional tower-like cloakroom element is unnecessary and should be reconsidered.

position.rationale: Potential added vertical element is approximated on the taller central offset volume.

negative.statement: The proposed cloakroom arrangement is neither operationally nor landscape-satisfactory and appears inaccessible and unattractive for bathers.

position.rationale: Cloakroom interior is not visible; a constrained location is placed within the lower central mass.

negative.statement: The parking arrangement requires further checking.

position.rationale: Parking is approximated at the open east-north site edge.

negative.statement: The support concept is complex, with large spans and demanding cantilevers.

position.rationale: Structural concern is assigned to the projecting and offset central upper volumes.

negative.statement: The unprotected ventilated timber facade is expected to generate maintenance costs.

position.rationale: East-facing envelope is visible, while timber protection details are not distinguishable.

negative.statement: The proposed outdoor pool accesses, parking situation, and photovoltaic provision require further review or clarification.

position.target: outdoor pool accesses, parking situation, and photovoltaic provision
position.rationale: Compound external provisions are approximated along the open east and south site edges.
